records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2023, increased by $4.4 billion, or 25%, compared to the year ended December 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: TIDAL primarily generates revenue from subscriptions to customers, and such subscriptions allow access to the song library, video library, and improved sound quality.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross profit was $7.5 billion, up 25% year over year, driven primarily by our Cash App and Square ecosystems.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The prevailing bitcoin prices fluctuated significantly within each year, but the average price for 2023 was only approximately 2% higher than 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2023, operating loss was $278.8 million and Adjusted Operating Income was $351.4 million, a decrease of 55% and an increase of 342% year over year, respectively.
